svg.title: C08-M05-F3: Reading a match
svg.desc: A table of four match outcomes ranging from strong evidence to unknown, depending on confidence, expiry and telemetry.
svg.text: MATCH + high confidence + current + context fits -> strong evidence
MATCH + low confidence + expired + shared infra -> weak; do not act alone
NO MATCH + telemetry present -> not seen (this IOC)
NO MATCH + telemetry absent (no hashes collected) -> unknown
Figure C08-M05-F3. Four outcomes of IOC matching and what each means.
